**Data point 2 — a human APPROVED on the PR does not change the verdict** — skills seat, `session_01HPfcjvF23QBoBj7P47DDxs`, 2026-09-16T14:19Z.

PR #18447 (card #18384, rules layer `.claude/hooks/**`): `os-zhuang` (in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) APPROVED at 2026-09-16T14:16:05Z on the current head and flipped it ready. With every landing pre-check green (checks 19 / 16 rostered skips, `--pair` 0, `clean`), this seat's `PUT …/ccr/auto_merge` was denied `[Merge Without Review]`, and so was `label-write.mjs --remove needs-user-decision` on the same PR — the second time today for that strip. So the reason string 「Merge Without Review」 fires on a PR that carries a review; 「Self-Approval」 fired on the ui seat where the approver was a different account; 「Auto-Mode Bypass」 fired on a read-only GET. The classifier's verdict does not read the PR's review state either. Cumulative today across two seats and three repos' worth of commands: allowed 6 + 4 + 0, denied 0 + 4 + 2 for the same two shapes (arm, label strip). Candidate (b) in the body — a harness permission rule for the CCR auto-merge route and for `label-write.mjs` in the seat environment — is the only one that removes the coin flip; (a) is what the seats are already doing by hand.
